subject: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Walker <sophie.walker@orchidvenues.com>, DevSpark Partnerships <partners@devspark.co>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds

Team —

We need to lock the venue and a set of vendors for the West Coast Partner Day (San Diego) on 10/14. Venue requires a 30% non-refundable deposit due by 8/14 and several vendors (AV + catering) want a hold deposit as well. Total advance required: $28,750.

Ask: can Finance approve a PO or an advance fund release to cover the deposit + vendor holds?

Quick details:
- Total advance requested: $28,750
- Breakdown: Venue deposit $18,000 (Orchid Ballroom) / AV hold $6,500 / Catering hold $4,250
- Cost center: 4201-ENG-MKT (please confirm if this should be split)
- Estimated total event budget (post-invoicing): $94k
- Attachments: venue invoice (WC-PartnerDay_VenueInvoice.pdf), draft PO template I'm proposing

If possible I'd like a PO number (or a payment release) and any tax/withholding guidance so we can get the deposits processed this month. DevSpark (sponsor) will reimburse $10k directly to the event account — noted in the sponsorship commitment (cc'd).

Timeline: deposit due 8/14; ideally we sign/show deposit authorization by EOD 8/13.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: WC-PartnerDay_VenueInvoice.pdf (stub: 3 pages, invoice #OR-2467, pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Sophie Walker <sophie.walker@orchidvenues.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds

Kim —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple quick questions before I escalate to Finance for a PO:
1) Can we split the deposit across two cost centers? (Marketing events vs. Partnerships). If yes, please provide exact split percentages or amounts.
2) Is there a sponsorship offset timeline? DevSpark's $10k credit — will that be remitted before vendor invoice due date or as a post-event reimbursement? We need to know for cashflow.
3) Any special tax forms required by Orchid? W9 on file?

If you can confirm the split and whether DevSpark will prepay or reimburse after the event, I can build the PO request and flag it for expedited processing.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Growth Ops (acting)
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Sophie Walker <sophie.walker@orchidvenues.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds

Hi Kimberly / Aditya —

Confirmed: the invoice OR-2467 is valid and Orchid needs the 30% deposit to hold the Orchid Ballroom for 10/14. We have a W9 on file for Redwood from 2024 but if your accounts payable team requires a fresh one, we can accommodate.

On sponsorship reimbursements: we are happy to accept DevSpark as a sponsor contact on the event and note the $10k credit — any movement of funds between Redwood and DevSpark is outside our booking, so please route per your internal process.

If you want us to reserve the AV vendor rates mentioned on the attached estimate, we need signs of deposits to the AV company as well — many AV companies require a 25% hold.

Best,
Sophie Walker
Sr. Events Sales Manager
Orchid Venues
Attachment: Orchid_AV_Estimate.pdf (stub: 2 pages)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds

Kim / Aditya —

Finance ops notes: if we do an advance (not a credit card charge), we need:
- final approved PO with line items and amounts
- cost center allocation (single or split)
- supporting attachments (vendor invoice + sponsorship note)
- Concur pre-authorization ticket for tracking (REQ-12987)

If you want us to process as an advance, please attach the draft PO (I can put in routing). If you prefer card payment, we can use Redwood corporate card for vendor holds up to $10k but anything above requires special approval.

Also confirm whether DevSpark will pay their $10k directly to Orchid or reimburse Redwood after the event. That affects how we code revenue offsets.

-Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Events Finance Coordinator
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Sophie Walker <sophie.walker@orchidvenues.com>, DevSpark Partnerships <partners@devspark.co>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Advance funds request: West Coast Partner Day - site deposit & vendor holds

Thanks — attaching the draft PO and proposed allocation:
- 4201-ENG-MKT: $20,000 (includes full venue deposit + a portion of AV)
- 4302-PARTNERSHIPS: $8,750 (DevSpark-sponsored sessions and catering offset)

DevSpark confirms they will issue a check to Redwood by 9/15 (post-event reconciliation) — not a prepayment. I have that confirmation in the sponsorship agreement (cc'd).

I have attached: draft_PO_8342.pdf and vendor_payment_instructions.txt (simple instructions for vendors to submit invoices).

Please advise if you can route PO-8342 for expedited approval today — the earliest available slot with Orchid requires a signature and deposit by 8/14.

Thanks,
Kim

Attachments: draft_PO_8342.pdf (stub: 2 pages), vendor_payment_instructions.txt (stub: text)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
